mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate by more than 0.5 percentage points over three months signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls by >0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), central bank's reluctance to tighten policy despite inflation drives equity risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC for joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals expanding manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over six months signals economic weakness that triggers flight to quality, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.3pp in 6 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates supply-demand mismatch that creates economic uncertainty, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and HOUST rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 1.5% YoY) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), central bank's tightening cycle reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC for joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
